headline: Triumph for Norway in Tense 2-1 Knockout Battle
whyCareReason: A decisive Round of 32 knockout match with one team advancing and one sent home from the 2026 World Cup.
teaser: The final whistle blew at BC Place with a 2-1 scoreline. Norway and Ivory Coast played out an absorbing contest in this Round of 32 fixture.
story:
Under the bright lights in Vancouver, Norway and Ivory Coast took to the pitch on 2026-06-30 for a highly anticipated knockout fixture. The tension in the stadium was palpable, reflecting the immense stakes of the tournament.

With both managers deploying disciplined defensive setups, space was at a premium. Erling Haaland showed moments of brilliance for Norway, while Simon Adingra was the creative heartbeat for Ivory Coast. In the end, a few decisive moments settled the score at 2-1, giving fans plenty to talk about.

For the victors, this result represents a massive step toward their World Cup dreams. For the defeated, it is a heartbreaking end to their campaign.
stakes: In the Round of 32, there is no room for error. A single loss means the end of the World Cup dream for either Norway or Ivory Coast.
rivalryAngle: The footballing connection between Norway and Ivory Coast adds an extra layer of emotion to this fixture, making it a must-watch for fans.
funFacts: Norway are affectionately known as the Løvene.
Ivory Coast are affectionately known as the Les Éléphants.
This high-profile match was held at BC Place in Vancouver on 2026-06-30.
